# Rule: Authoritative Referencing — Per-Surface Homes, Scaling & Failure Tells (Companion Sub-Rule)

## Purpose

Carry the per-surface referencing-home consolidation list, the seriousness-scaling table, and the failure-tells enumeration that `rules/authoritative-referencing.md` §3, §Seriousness-Scaling, and §Failure-tells anchors declare. The parent rule keeps the four standing obligations — every claim carries a source (§1), authoritative / official / current (§2), no folklore (§4), and when to consult a live source (§5); this companion carries the by-reference consolidation catalog naming each per-surface home, the level-by-level enforcement table, and the diagnostic tells of the referencing bar broken, so the parent stays lean while the situational detail loads on the surfaces where a claim is actually cited. Path-filtered: it demand-loads on documentation, site, and research-manuscript touches — where a referencing home is cited or a claim rests on a source.

## 1. Consolidate by reference, not restatement (Parent §3 Detail)

Each per-surface referencing home keeps its single authoritative form and is cited from the parent, never duplicated:

- **`rules/ten-dimension-check.md` dimension 9** — the scholarly / technical referencing dimension every artifact passes at emission.
- **`rules/sota-elevation.md` §2** — the named-exemplar discipline (a currently-shipping project, never "industry standard").
- **`rules/disclosure-ledger.md`** — the rationale-citation bar every ledger marker meets.
- **`output-styles/default.md` §Citations** — the link-the-source rendering on user-facing output.

## 2. Seriousness Scaling (Parent §Seriousness-Scaling Detail)

| Level | Referencing obligation |
| ----- | ---------------------- |
| EXPLORING | Cite where a claim is load-bearing; folklore avoided. |
| PERSONAL_USE | Cite material claims; named sources for non-obvious facts. |
| SHARED | Every meaningful-scope claim cited to an authoritative current source. |
| PUBLIC_LAUNCH | Every public-surface claim cited; no folklore; superseded sources refreshed to the in-force edition. |

## 3. Failure tells (Parent §Failure-tells Detail)

A claim stated as settled with no citable source; "industry standard" / "best practice" / "everyone knows" offered as the authority; a citation to a downstream aggregator where the primary owner exists; a superseded edition cited as current; a SOTA citation with no named currently-shipping exemplar.

## Enforcement

Path-filtered (the nine glob patterns in this rule's `pathFilter` field — docs / site / README / research / manuscript / paper / literature / bibliography and TeX files), always-on at every seriousness level when in scope. Demand-loaded companion to `rules/authoritative-referencing.md` §3 / §Seriousness-Scaling / §Failure-tells. The parent rule carries the §1 every-claim-carries-a-source obligation, the §2 authoritative / official / current bar, the §4 no-folklore obligation, and the §5 when-to-consult-a-live-source directive; this companion carries the four per-surface referencing homes, the four-level scaling table, and the failure-tells enumeration.
